1879073753.name: Crippling Bite
1879073753.desc: A sharp snap of your jaws and your target's movement is slowed.

1879095257.name: Spider's Venom (Ranged)
1879095257.desc: This warband skill does direct ranged damage to your target, then morale over time and can contribute to warband manoeuvres.

1879176281.name: Guide to Mirk-eaves
1879176281.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Mirk-eaves.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879213913.name: A Flesh Wound (Tactical)
1879213913.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front right leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879243993.name: Rider and Steed
1879243993.desc: You forge a stronger bond between you and your steed. Surrounding allies also form a stronger bond with their steed.

1879244249.name: Trick: Stratagem
1879244249.desc: A good Burglar knows how to plan for any situation and how to apply their knowledge to the best outcome at all times.

1879302617.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Defender)
1879302617.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879315033.name: Horse of Bounty
1879315033.desc: A horse from the Farmers Faire.

1879316057.name: Ferocious Roar
1879316057.desc: Unleash a mighty roar that generates a large amount of Wrath. Guarantees your next Beorning mounted skill will crit.

1879339353.name: Hallows-eve Kite
1879339353.desc: Brings out a Hallows-eve kite for you to fly!

1879352153.name: Steed of the Ash Plains
1879352153.desc: A steed clad in the raiment of the Ash Plains.

1879409497.name: Speak No Evil
1879409497.desc: Removes up to 3 corruptions from the target.

1879479129.name: Harmonious Falcon
1879479129.desc: Summons a falcon to accompany you on your travels.

1879486041.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Umbari Guardsman)
1879486041.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879488729.name: Major Pet Command
1879488729.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879493465.name: Cobra
1879493465.desc: Summons a mesmerizing sand-striker to accompany you on your adventures.

1879497689.name: Sign of the Wild: Rage
1879497689.desc: Command your pet to attack their target with a wild and damaging attack.\n\nUsing Fire, Frost, and Lightning skills will reduce the active cooldown of this ability.

1879509337.name: Stealthed Surprise Strike
1879509337.desc:
Strike the enemy, dealing more damage from behind or when Stealthed.

Critical hits with Surprise Strike are more damaging than most skills.<RGB=#00ff00>

 +10% Positional Damage
 +100% Critical Magnitude</RGB>

1879520601.name: Guise of Daxamat
1879520601.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Daxamat, the brother of Jajax.

1879521369.name: Sea-borne Slime
1879521369.desc: Summons a sea-borne slime to accompany you on your travels.

1879527385.name: Delothlin Gem
1879527385.desc: Channel the power of the gem to cleanse the target of the TBD Curse. This power will also harm the user.
